subject: Novacare POC: ramp credits & per-token breakpoints
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@novacare.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novacare pilot / pricing questions

Hi Marissa / Sergio,

Thanks for the demo today — the latency and cost breakdown were helpful. We want to scope a 30-day POC to validate two flows: (1) conversational triage (avg sequence 700 tokens, estimated 2M tokens/month baseline) and (2) nightly batch ranking (shorter sequences, spikes up to ~15M tokens/month during onboarding).

Two asks up front:
- Can you outline a simple per-token pricing cadence for hosted API usage (what breakpoints / tier prices do you recommend for a company that may ramp to 50M+ tokens/month)?
- We need an onboarding / launch incentive: some free credits for a 30-day pilot that also give us runway to test production throughput. Are launch credits conditional on a committed volume or can they be unconditional?

Also: does the pilot credit cover streamed responses and embedding calls, or is that excluded?

If you can send a one-page pilot credit proposal and a rough mutual action plan (SOW timeline + legal review window), we can coordinate internal approvals. CCing Timothy (VP Engineering) for procurement visibility.

Best,
Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of AI, NovaCare
elaine@novacare.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@novacare.ai>
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novacare pilot / pricing questions

Thanks Elaine — great to meet you. Attaching a brief pilot credit schedule that lays out a recommended POC and launch incentive. High level summary below (attachment: novacare_pilot_credit_schedule.xlsx).

Proposed pilot offer (30 days):
- Uncommitted pilot: $10,000 in free credits applied to hosted API calls (covers generation + streaming + embeddings). Credits expire 60 days after issuance.
- If a post-POC commitment is signed within 60 days, NovaCare receives an additional $15,000 launch credit to be applied across the first 90 days of production.

Suggested committed pricing (example breakpoints, per-token):
- 0–10M tokens: $0.00025 / token
- 10M–50M tokens: $0.00020 / token
- 50M+ tokens: $0.00016 / token

Ramp accelerator: one-time $5,000 credit if actual usage in the first 90 days exceeds forecast by >=25% (helps cover onboarding spikes).

Notes / constraints:
- Credits apply to hosted API usage (generation, streaming, embeddings). Fine-grained attribution will show up in Console billing.
- Commit tiers are volume-based and evaluated monthly; we can add model-family adjustments if you use larger-context models.
- SOW: I attached a draft SOW (high-level). If acceptable, we can route to legal for a 7–10 business day review.

Next steps:
1) Review attached spreadsheet and SOW.
2) Internal thumbs-up from your procurement/legal.
3) We issue pilot credits and schedule kickoff.

Happy to jump on a quick sync if helpful.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior GTM — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Timothy Ruiz <timothy@novacare.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Novacare pilot / pricing questions — slab suggestion

Quick thought on the slab structure before we send a final: given NovaCare's mixed workload (long conv contexts + short batch calls) we should consider a blended effective rate rather than only raw token breakpoints. Options:
- Keep the breakpoints but offer an "avg-rate" guarantee: if the monthly weighted average (generation+embedding) is above X tokens, cap the effective e-rate at $0.00018/token for the first 3 months after commit.
- Alternatively, swap the one-time launch credit for a 3-month percent rebate (e.g., 8% of billed usage) to simplify accounting for them.

Operational asks: we should require a short forecast (monthly expected tokens) and a 30-day notice before a >50% sustained ramp to ensure capacity reservation. Also recommend adding an explicit model-family mapping clause: Llama 2 70B quantized vs smaller encoder-only models have different token cost profiles — this affects the breakpoints.

I'll stitch a short paragraph into the SOW with the blended-rate option as an optional addendum. Sergio / Marissa — flag if you want me to present this to the customer.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Pricing & Packaging
Redwood Inference

Thanks — this is helpful. A few clarifications before we lock dates: 

1) Confirmed: pilot credits cover streaming responses and embedding calls (good).
2) Credit expiry: 60 days is acceptable, but can we request a one-time 30-day extension if internal approval runs over?
3) Example billing: can you send one worked example showing billable tokens for (a) a 700-token conversation with streaming and (b) a 2M-token batch ranking job, including how credits are consumed and how the ramp accelerator would apply?
4) Legal/procurement: we expect a 10–15 business day legal review window for the SOW. Any standard contract redlines we should be aware of?

If those answers look ok, we'll move to issue a PO for the pilot and schedule the kickoff.

Thanks Elaine — good questions. Short answers inline and then the proposed mutual action plan.

- Credit expiry extension: we can offer a one-time 30-day extension if procurement needs it (we'll note that in the SOW).
- Worked billing examples: attached in the spreadsheet (summary below). Example: a 700-token streamed conversation uses ~700 generation tokens + 30 embedding tokens for context indexing; billed against credits at the sequence granularity. A 2M-token batch run consumes tokens against the pilot credits first; if credits exhaust, standard per-token rates apply.
- Legal redlines: typical exceptions we see are around indemnity limits and data residency; our standard SOW includes Redwoods' model usage terms and a 45-day SLA rectification timeline. We can pull a short list of common redlines for your counsel.
